evidence.evidence_text: $f \propto r^{-α} \cdot (r+γ)^{-β}$ has been empirically shown more precise than a naïve power law $f\propto r^{-α}$ to model the rank-frequency ($r$-$f$) relation of words in natural languages.
A method of parameter estimation by searching an optimal $γ$ is proposed, where a ``zeroth word'' is introduced technically for the calculation.
